title: Downtown Dallas Historic Food Tour: Taste What Dallas Invented
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Dallas didn't just make history it invented the food you're about to eat. On this 3-hour walking tour through the Historic West End and Downtown Dallas, you'll taste the dishes this city actually created, stand where JFK was assassinated, and eat your way through the landmarks every visitor comes to see with a local guide who knows the stories behind all of it. Slow-cooked Texas BBQ, scratch-made Tex-Mex, and an ice-cold drink at every stop. Gluten-free options available at every stop.
